name: School Gradebook Teacher
description: Tracks student marks, averages, pass/fail status, and grade distribution charts

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you calculate student marks in your spreadsheet?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Student scores are in columns B through F. In column G, I write =SUM(B2:F2) to get total marks, and in column H I write =AVERAGE(B2:F2) to get their percentage average.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you determine if a student passed?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use =IF(H2>=40,"Pass","Fail"). If average H2 is at least 40, it shows Pass. When I copy this formula down to row 30, relative references automatically evaluate each student.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you show the pass rate to parents?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I select data for the Pass and Fail counts and insert a chart. I add a title like Term 1 Results and label each slice so parents see the breakdown clearly.
